svg.title: Intervention step: patient radar profile matched against activity image grid
svg.desc: The patient profile is now a spider plot over 7 MoCA (teal) and 4 ARAT (green) subscales on the left. The right card shows a 3 by 7 grid of RGS activities; each cell shows the activity thumbnail framed by its match-score colour. The top 3 activities are highlighted plus an ellipsis for the remaining nine in the top-12 prescription.
svg.text: Activities are ranked by match score
